solid_consistent.title: Solid, consistent presence
solid_consistent.paragraph: Content gets a steady response and the cadence is reliable. The next lever is to diversify formats and open more conversation in the comments.

irregular_reach.title: Strong reach, irregular rhythm
irregular_reach.paragraph: Content works when it ships, but publishing is uneven. Stabilising the weekly cadence is the step with the highest immediate return.

cadence_no_signal.title: Strong cadence, weak signal
cadence_no_signal.paragraph: There is publishing discipline, but content isn't converting into interaction. Focus should shift to the editorial concept and opening hook of each post.

no_direction.title: Audience exists, direction missing
no_direction.paragraph: The follower base isn't reacting or commenting meaningfully. The priority is to redefine editorial angle and formats before increasing volume.

opportunity.title: Active profile, clear opportunity
opportunity.paragraph: Indicators are close to the tier reference. There is room to lift engagement by adjusting dominant formats and reinforcing conversation in the comments.

funnel.question: Attract, educate, convert or retain?
funnel.body_lead: Mapping of content function along the journey — attention, education, decision or relationship.

bodies.Topo do funil: Most posts seek to capture attention and spark curiosity — strong for reach, weak for conversion.
bodies.Meio do funil: Most content educates and explains, positioning the profile as a reference before the decision.
bodies.Fundo do funil: Frequent calls to action — links, offers or contact requests.
bodies.Pós-venda / fidelização: The profile highlights customers, community and gratitude.
bodies.Comunicação dispersa: Attract, educate, convert and retain signals mix without a clearly dominant stage.

funnel.callout_body: Without a dominant stage, content may not be steering the audience in a clear direction. Defining intent per block of posts can improve editorial coherence.
